The encoder is `format_sse_event` in `fastapi/sse.py`, which writes lines in the order comment, `event:`, one `data:` per line, `id:`, `retry:`, then a blank line terminator. `fastapi/routing.py` calls it from `_serialize_sse_item` to turn each yielded `ServerSentEvent` into those bytes.

Concretely, `ServerSentEvent(data={"a":1}, event="tick", id="7", retry=3000, comment="hi\nthere")` becomes the UTF-8 bytes `: hi\n: there\nevent: tick\ndata: {"a": 1}\nid: 7\nretry: 3000\n\n`. Each line of a multi-line payload gets its own `data:` prefix, which the browser rejoins with newlines. Note that `splitlines()` means an empty `data` string emits no `data:` line at all.
